mentions.name: Garden Boxes
mentions.description: Hand-built raised garden boxes made from torched pine finished with the Shou Sugi Ban (Japanese wood-charring) technique. The boxes hold a garden at a much more convenient working height and are planned to support wintergarden experiments using high compost mixes that keep the garden from freezing in winter.
mentions.problem: Gardening at ground level is at an inconvenient height, and gardens can freeze during the winter.
mentions.audience: Gardening for personal use at home, including personal wintergarden experiments.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Garden Boxes

Specifically, torched pine Shou Sugi Ban boxes to house a garden at a much more convenient height for gardening, and eventually, my wintergarden experiments with high compost mixes to keep the garden from freezing in the winter.
